title: NO FINISH PROMPT WHILE YOU DIE
why: When you die there is a 1.5 second beat before the death card. In that beat the FINISH [V] ring and text stayed over a downed pillager in reach, though V does nothing while you die. Proven in the cloud: FINISH drawn over a downed pillager in reach, then the death, and every frame of the beat still drew FINISH while holding V did nothing. The prompt now needs you alive. Standing, it shows as before.
now: The FINISH prompt no longer hangs over a downed pillager while you die.
